name: 蘇昱瑋
objective:
介紹氣體的物理性質，熱力學第一、第二與第三定律，化學反應之熱能變化與動力學，以及系統中的相平衡。
This course contents the following subjects: the physical properties of gases, the first law, second law and third law of thermodynamics, enthalpy change in chemical reaction, chemical kinetic and the phase equilibrium in a system.
schedule:
week 1~2: Basic concepts of thermodynamics
week 3~4: Gas property 
week 5~6: The first law of thermodynamics
week 7~8: The second law of thermodynamics
week 9: midterm exam
week 10~11: The third law of thermodynamics
week 12~13: Chemical reaction
week 14~15: Thermodynamics web (Maxwell correlation)
week 16~17: Gas kinetics theory
week 18: Final exam
scorePolicy:
Midterm exam (25%)
Final (35%)
several times Quiz (30%) 
attendencen (10%)
materials:
1. ATKINS’ PHYSICAL CHEMISTRY (5th)
Peter Atkins

2. Physical Chemistry
Robert. G. Mortimer
